listing.intro: A cheerful Christmas bingo game with 30 unique cards, filled with holiday favorites like candy canes, gingerbread, cozy pajamas and twinkle lights. The words are big and easy to read, so young kids, teens and grandparents can all play together. It is great for family parties, classroom celebrations, office parties and senior centers.
details: 30 different cards, so no two players have the same card
Use candy, buttons or a crayon as markers
